content.metaDesc: Fotoage is the first customizable laser HDD mask (High Density Diodes) in aesthetic medicine — used with the Skinox range at YourHealthFirst Clinic, Harley Street.
content.heading: 1st Customizable Biophotonic Mask
content.subtitle: Fotoage is the first customizable laser HDD mask (High Density Diodes) in aesthetic medicine.
content.introP1: Fotoage is the first customizable laser HDD mask (High Density Diodes) in aesthetic medicine. It activates the stem cells, allowing an increase in the repair and healing of tissues.
content.introP2: HDD or High Density Diode is a much more powerful light compared to LED, which can concentrate a higher amount of energy in a larger area. It is also capable of emitting pure monochromatic light. For these reasons, it is more effective than other types of chromotherapy treatments.
content.hddHeading: How Does HDD (High Density Diodes) Laser Light From Fotoage Help in Medical Treatments?
content.hddP1: HDD or High Density Diodes therapy is an innovative technology, and Fotoage is suitable to treat multiple conditions in aesthetic medicine.
content.hddP2: In combination with the Skinox range of photosensitive products, it allows four different skin treatments, depending on the colour of the laser light (red, blue, yellow or green) applied to the skin.
content.customP1: Fotoage offers the specialist the possibility of treating several cutaneous affections at the same time, since it has 4 independent treatment areas that, in addition, adapt ergonomically to the curves of the patient's face and neck.
content.blueP3: Inhibits the growth of the horny layer
